title: 第九章 招揽人手第十章 草台班子
lines: 合宫县福运楼是全县最大的食肆，羊肉煮熟后佐以胡椒去膻味是主菜，胡饼沾上辣子和芝麻再加上馎饦是主食，朱恩狼吞虎咽的吃掉半只羊，酒足饭饱之后，看着岳峰鸣鸣的哭了起来。
“岳兄啊，魏生明让我蹲了大牢，让人打我还要杀我的头，我咬紧牙关什么也没说啊！？
我只是个不良人，怎么就惹上了这么多事儿了？我都以为再没有机会见到你了，这辈子就这么完蛋了，如果不是岳兄你搭救我，我命都要搭上去，我真的害怕了，真的害怕啊！”朱恩道。
作为不良人，朱恩只不过想凭此混一口饭吃，可是从驿所遇到“浮逃”开始，他就被卷入到了这一连串的事情之中，下了大牢之后，活阎罗“魏生明”是真的把他往死里整呢，他的心身都饱受压力，能够挺住实属不易，现在能重见天日，他立刻绷不住了。
岳峰用力拍了拍他的肩膀，道：“你是不良人，我还只是一田舍儿呢！我招谁惹谁了？本来是来服力役的，结果险些送了命，现在也不是惹到了官司？
所以，这一切都是命，你我兄弟不惹事也不怕事儿，有道是生死有命富贵在天，事已至此，我们只能放手一搏了，万一失败了，最多也就掉脑袋，怕什么？脑袋掉了也就碗大个疤！
而倘若搏赢了，你我兄弟兴许还能搏一个前程出来，总比浑浑噩噩，平平庸庸过一辈子要强，兄弟你说是不是？”
朱恩道：“岳兄非常人，我信你的，现在啥也别说了，以后你就是我大哥，我无论生死都追随您！只是你为了救我，和魏生明赌蹴鞠，而且以十天为期限，这……这实在是太凶险，哪里来的胜算？”
岳峰道：“既然是放手一搏，就不会有绝对的胜算，但是我相信，这天下总有英雄，王侯将相宁有种呼？我们就从不良人中筛选出一飙人马来和这魏生明斗一斗，你负责联络，我负责牵头，我们一起干他个轰轰烈烈，掀三班衙门一个底儿朝天！”
朱恩本来十分悲观，可是听岳峰这么一说，心中却凭空生出一股豪情来，他一拍桌子，往嘴里塞进了半张胡饼，干了一杯绿蚁，道：
“大哥，事不迟疑，我现在就去联络！”
朱恩站起身来，忽然厅堂旁边传来一声大笑，道：“什么人在这里口出狂言，扰老子清净？”
岳峰心中一惊，扭头看向旁边，见隔壁桌子上端坐着一名胡服壮汉，看此人，鼻梁突出，头发微带黄色，似乎有胡人血统，那一脸的络腮胡子配合那一双锐利的鹰眼模样很凶。
周围的食客很多，都齐齐往这边看过来，朱恩道：“这位兄台！我们兄弟说话碍你什么事儿了？”
“就是碍老子的事儿了！”胡服壮汉豁然起身，盯着岳峰两人！
他用手指着岳峰，道：“你姓岳？是你杀了那秦厉云？”
朱恩怒道：“你胡说八道什么？秦捕头乃‘浮逃’所杀，岳兄弟撞上了，一人斩杀了五名浮逃救了主薄大人的命，这事儿合宫县衙，人人皆知，你岂能诬陷我岳兄弟杀人？……”
“哄！”周围人齐齐轰动，周围的食客看向岳峰的目光立刻就不一样了，最近合宫县最大的新闻便是捕头秦厉云遭遇了横祸，被人杀死。而那几个杀人的浮逃又被主薄大人的书吏强势斩杀，原来那神奇的书吏就是眼前的这个少年？
看岳峰的模样，生得并不算高大魁梧，反而面孔生得颇为秀气，他这模样能一人杀五名浮逃？
众人指指点点，叽叽喳喳，那胡服汉子一拍桌子，长笑一声道：“敢杀不敢承认么？老子强二郎最讨厌这类敢做不敢当之人。
今日老子就称量称量你，看看你究竟有几分本事！”
胡服汉子说罢，手一按桌子，如猿猴一般跳跃起来直扑岳峰，当面冲着他的面门就是一拳。
岳峰一个梭步后退，伸手也是一拳，双方的拳头在空中对垒，岳峰微微皱眉，往后退了几步，胡服汉子则是“蹬”、“蹬”、“蹬”一连退了十几步才勉强立足，还差点跌了一跤。
胡服汉子双眼一翻，喝道：“好个手段，再来！”
他揉身再一次扑上去，又和岳峰战成一团，他的身手不俗，可是岳峰的身手更加的敏捷，几个回合下来，胡服汉子就落了下风。
岳峰抓住了他的一个破绽，一掌从中门攻破防御，胡服汉子肩头被打得一晃，岳峰用脚轻巧的一勾，便让他跌了一个狗啃屎。
周围立刻响起雷鸣般的喝彩声，大唐人豪情万丈，喜欢英雄，也喜欢热闹，平常民间都有角斗相扑一类的比赛，岳峰刚才和壮汉交手的时间虽然短，但是双方的身手都颇高，兔起鹘落十分的精彩，因而围观众人都忍不住叫好。
壮汉跌在地上，竟然也不恼，从地上爬起来冲着岳峰抱拳道：“嗯，你果然好手段，秦厉云栽在你的手上不冤！只是你这一次欲要和魏生明斗，姓魏的在合宫县一手遮天，谁敢和他作对？你指望要在不良人中找帮手，只能是异想天开了……”
岳峰心念转动，道：“魏生明强则强矣，可是酷吏治下有冤屈，岳某坚信合宫县里的英雄还没有死绝，岳某定能结交英雄，将这魏生明战而胜之！”
他顿了顿，话锋一转道：“强兄弟我看你武艺超群，定然也是有抱负之人！汝可敢和我们一起，放手一搏？”
胡服壮汉微微愣了一下，岳峰冷笑一声道：“怎么？我看强兄弟莫非是不敢？大丈夫在世，岂能庸庸碌碌？要想富贵就得拿命来搏，强兄弟以为如何？”
胡服汉子浑身一震，喝道：“谁说我不敢？我强二郎等的就是这等机会！回头我们几兄弟一起去县衙，咱们就和姓魏的斗一斗！”
岳峰心情也大好，大笑一声道：“好！今日我找到了强兄弟这样的英雄，当把酒言欢！来啊，再煮五斤羊肉，瓮一壶绿蚁，我们兄弟今日把酒言欢，不醉不归！”
content_en:
Fuyunlou in Hegong County is the largest restaurant in the county. Lamb is cooked and served with pepper to remove the odor. Hu pancakes dipped in chili pepper and sesame and served with buns are the staple food. Zhu En devoured half of the sheep. After he was full of wine and rice, he looked at Yue Feng and started to cry.
"Brother-in-law, Wei Shengming put me in jail and had people beat me and kill my head. I gritted my teeth and didn't say anything!?
I'm just a bad person, why did I get into so many troubles? I thought I would never have the chance to see you again, and that my life would be over. If you hadn’t rescued me, brother-in-law, my life would have been in danger. I was really scared, really scared! "June said.
As a bad person, Zhu En just wanted to earn a living through this, but he was involved in a series of things starting from the "escape" in the post office. After he was imprisoned, the living hell "Wei Shengming" really tried to kill him. He was under pressure both physically and mentally. It was not easy to hold on. Now that he could see the light of day again, he couldn't hold it anymore.
Yue Feng patted him hard on the shoulder and said: "You are a bad person, I am just a farm boy! Who did I provoke? I was originally here to serve in the army, but I almost lost my life. Now I am not in trouble with a lawsuit?"
Therefore, all of this is fate. You and I, brothers, don’t cause trouble and are not afraid of trouble. There is a way of life and death. Wealth and wealth are in the sky. Now that the matter has come to this, we can only give it a try. If we fail, we will lose our heads at most. What are we afraid of? If the head falls off, it will only have a scar as big as a bowl!
And if we win the fight, you and I, brothers, may be able to fight for a future, which is better than living a mediocre life, brother, don’t you think so? "
Zhu En said: "Brother Yue is a very human being. I believe you. Don't say anything now. You will be my eldest brother from now on. I will follow you no matter life or death! But in order to save me, you bet with Wei Shengming on Cuju, and the deadline is ten days. This... this is really too dangerous. Where is the chance of winning?"
Yue Feng said: "Since we are giving it a try, there is no absolute chance of winning, but I believe that there are always heroes in this world, and princes, generals, and ministers have the right spirit? We will select a group of bad guys to fight against this Wei Shengming. You will be responsible for contacting me, and I will be responsible for taking the lead. We will do it together with great force, and bring down the third class of Yamen!"
Zhu En was originally very pessimistic, but when he heard what Yue Feng said, he suddenly felt a surge of pride in his heart. He slammed the table, stuffed half a piece of biscuit into his mouth, drank a cup of green ants, and said:
"Brother, don't hesitate, I'll contact you now!"
Zhu En stood up, and suddenly a loud laugh came from the side of the hall, saying: "Who is talking arrogantly here and disturbing my purity?"
Yue Feng was startled. He turned to look to the side and saw a strong man in Hu clothes sitting at the table next door. This man had a protruding nose and slightly yellow hair. He seemed to be of Hu origin. The beard on his face and the sharp eagle eyes looked very fierce.
There were many diners around, and they all looked over here. Zhu En said, "Brother! Why are our brothers talking to you?"
"It's just a problem for me!" The strong man in Hufu suddenly stood up and stared at Yue Feng and the two!
He pointed at Yue Feng and said, "Your surname is Yue? Did you kill that Qin Liyun?"
Zhu En said angrily: "What nonsense are you talking about? Qin's leader was killed by Fu Fu. Brother Yue bumped into him. One of them killed five Fu Fu and saved Lord Bo's life. This matter is known to everyone in Hegong County Yamen. How can you frame my brother Yue for murder?..."
"Coax!" The people around him all roared. The diners around him looked at Yue Feng in a different way. The biggest news in Hegong County recently was that the head catcher Qin Liyun encountered a misfortune and was killed. And those murderous fugitives were violently killed by Master Bo's scribe. It turned out that the magical scribe was the young man in front of him?
Judging from Yue Feng's appearance, he is not tall and burly, but has a rather delicate face. Can he kill five people and run away with him like this?
Everyone pointed and chirped, and the man in the hooded clothes slapped the table and said with a long laugh: "Do you dare to kill but dare not admit it? I, Qiang Erlang, hate this kind of people the most who dare to do something but not take it seriously.
Today I will weigh you and see how capable you are! "
After saying this, the man in Hufu put his hand on the table, jumped up like an ape and rushed towards Yue Feng, punching him in the face.
Yue Feng stepped back, stretched out his hand and punched. The fists of the two sides faced each other in the air. Yue Feng frowned slightly and took a few steps back. The man in the Hufu took "kick", "kick" and "kick" for more than ten steps in a row before he managed to gain a foothold and almost fell.
The man in Hufu rolled his eyes and shouted: "What a trick, come again!"
He rubbed his body and rushed forward again, fighting Yue Feng again. His skills were good, but Yue Feng's skills were even more agile. After a few rounds, the man in Hufu was at a disadvantage.
Yue Feng caught one of his weaknesses and broke through the defense with a palm from the middle. The man in Hufu was hit on the shoulder, and Yue Feng made a light hook with his foot, causing him to fall to his knees.
Thunderous cheers immediately rang out from the surroundings. People of the Tang Dynasty were full of pride, they loved heroes, and they also loved excitement. There were usually competitions such as gladiatorial wrestling and sumo wrestling among the people. Although Yue Feng had just fought against the strong man for a short time, both sides were very skilled. The rabbit raised and the falcon fell very wonderfully, so the onlookers couldn't help but applaud.
The strong man fell to the ground, but he was not upset. He got up from the ground and clasped his fists at Yue Feng and said: "Well, you are really good at it. Qin Liyun is not unjust in your hands! It's just that this time you want to fight Wei Shengming. The man surnamed Wei dominates the sky in Hegong County. Who dares to go against him? You can only hope to find helpers among bad people, but you are just fanciful..."
Yue Feng's mind turned and said: "Wei Shengming is strong when he is strong, but there are injustices under the rule of cruel officials. Yue firmly believes that the heroes in Hegong County are not dead yet. Yue will definitely be able to make friends with heroes and defeat Wei Shengming in battle!"
He paused, then changed the subject and said, "Brother Qiang, I think you are superb in martial arts, and you must be an ambitious person! Do you dare to join us and give it a try?"
The strong man in Hufu was stunned for a moment, and Yue Feng sneered and said: "What? I think Brother Qiang doesn't dare? How can a man be mediocre when he is alive? If you want to be rich, you have to risk your life. What does Brother Qiang think?"
The man in Hufu was shocked and shouted: "Who said I don't dare? This is the opportunity that I, Qiang Erlang, have been waiting for! We brothers will go to the county government together later, and we will have a fight with the man named Wei!"
Yue Feng was also in a good mood and laughed loudly and said: "Okay! Today I have found a hero like Brother Qiang. Let's drink and talk with each other! Come on, cook another five kilograms of mutton and put a pot of green ants in the pot. We brothers will drink and talk with each other today until we get drunk."
title_en: Chapter 9 Recruiting People Chapter 10 Grass Team
